facts.title: Shader Gradient
facts.description: Create beautiful moving gradients on Framer, Figma and React

research.name: ShaderGradient
research.note: Editor for animated, grainy 3D shader gradients, offered as a web customizer, Figma and Framer plugins and a React component.

effects: Grainy noise-displaced 3D gradient planes and spheres
Gradient settings encoded in a shareable customizer URL

unverified: The components' source is public in the GitHub repository ruucm/shadergradient, linked from the site; that repository has not yet been researched in place of this site.
Pricing is inferred: no prices were shown, and I could not confirm the Framer and Figma plugins are free.
